ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Sponsor sales, Negotiating and later stages need Amount, Payment terms and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sponsor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Prospect", 1, "Meeting held", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiating", 4, "Contract out", 5, "Signed", 6, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(TEXT(Payment_terms__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Payment terms and Next step date before moving to Negotiating.
